questions.knowledge_point: Solving for a Vector in a Linear Combination
questions.problem:
Find the value of ${x}_{3}-{x}_{4}$ given that  $6a-2x=b$ and

$$
a=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 6 \\ 8\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6 \\ -12 \\ -10\end{aligned}].
$$
questions.worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}6a-2x & =b \\ -2x & =b-6a \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}(b-6a) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}([\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6 \\ -12 \\ -10\end{aligned}]-6[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 6 \\ 8\end{aligned}]) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}-16 \\ 6 \\ -48 \\ -58\end{aligned}] \\ x & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -3 \\ 24 \\ 29\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{3}-{x}_{4}=24-29=-5.$

questions.knowledge_point: Solving for Three Coefficients in a Linear Combination
questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then   we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -1 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -{x}_{3} \\ -3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-2 \\ -{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=5 \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & 5 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=(-1){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -5 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -12\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-2 \\ {x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-5 \\ 0=-12.\end{aligned}
$$

However, the final equation $0=-12$  gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.

questions.knowledge_point: Solving for Three Coefficients in a Linear Combination
questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ {x}_{3} \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2}+{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=-3 \\ 5{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=4 \\ 3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-4\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0.2 & 0.8 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=-{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0.2 & 0.8 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=-3 \\ {x}_{2}+\,0.2{x}_{3}=0.8 \\ {x}_{3}=-1.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=-1.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get 

$$
{x}_{2}+0.2(-1)=0.8\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=1.
$$

   

Finally,  substituting ${x}_{2}=1$ into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}-(1)=-3\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=-2.
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-2$, ${x}_{2}=1$, and ${x}_{3}=-1,$ which means  

$$
-2{a}_{1}+{a}_{2}-{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-2+1-1=-2.
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Solving for a Vector in a Linear Combination
questions.problem:
Find the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}$ given that $3a-5x=b$ and

$$
a=[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 5 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-13 \\ 5 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$
questions.worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3a-5x & =b \\ -5x & =b-3a \\ x & =-\frac{1}{5}(b-3a) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{5}([\begin{aligned}-13 \\ 5 \\ -3\end{aligned}]-3[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 5 \\ 4\end{aligned}]) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{5}[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -10 \\ -15\end{aligned}] \\ x & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-1+2=1.$

questions.knowledge_point: Solving for Two Coefficients in a Linear Combination
questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1} \\ -3{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-7{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-7{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-7{x}_{2}=-9 \\ -3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=3 \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=1\end{aligned}
$$

Adding the first and the second equations we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} & =-6 \\ {x}_{2} & =3,\end{aligned}
$$

which we substitute into the second equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}-3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=3 \\ -3{x}_{1}+5(3) & =3 \\ -3{x}_{1} & =-12 \\ {x}_{1} & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=4$ and ${x}_{2}=3$ into the third equation and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=1 \\ (4)-(3) & =1 \\ 1 & =1,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=4$ and ${x}_{2}=3,$ which means

$$
4{a}_{1}+3{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=4+3=7.
$$
